purpose: Freeze the next Skill-Pro evidence ladder before any new model/provider or downstream task execution: real first-party trajectories -> identity-attribution intervention -> SkillEvolution/PPO Gate -> frozen-pool behavioral replay.
registration_timing: Frozen after the zero-provider P0/P0b scheduler witness and before any P1/P2 model or task outcome exists. P0 itself is not relabeled as preregistered.

preconditions.required_status: all P0/P0b checks PASS on pinned Skill-Pro commit 3be7a9be2d4c024d132efe394d537404eba7e4c8

p1a_real_evidence_collection.environment_role: fast first-party behavioral substrate; ALFWorld is reserved for confirmatory expansion, not substituted post hoc if Mastermind is negative
p1a_real_evidence_collection.episode_selection: the first six valid episode attempts in one frozen collection stream after set_seed(42); runtime-invalid attempts invalidate the collection rather than being replaced based on reward

focal_seed_skill_selection.outcome_blind_rule: select the skill name with lexicographically smallest SHA256(name)

p1a_real_evidence_collection.selection_isolation: force the frozen focal skill semantic content during evidence collection; do not allow native skill-selection multiplicity to contaminate the credit/evolution experiment
evidence_freeze: persist all six Experience records regardless of reward
hash reward/trajectory/env/transitions while excluding only the later identity-attribution field
no trajectory editing, filtering, success balancing, or task replacement after outcomes
all P1 attribution arms consume the same frozen six semantic Experience records
p1a_real_evidence_collection.primary_collection_gate: all six episodes must be runtime-valid and produce nonempty transition traces; otherwise P1 stops as collection-invalid

arms.name: B_id_placebo
arms.prediction: reaches candidate-generation/PPO path; controls literal name change without multiplicity

arms.name: C_exact_split
arms.representation: two exact-semantic identities differing only in symbolic name
arms.prediction: returns before candidate-generation/PPO path despite semantic N=6

arms.name: D_pre_gate_quotient
arms.representation: reunite the exact class to the original canonical identity before the released readiness gate
arms.prediction: restores the same scheduler path as A without duplicating evidence

arms.name: E_late_identity_dedup
arms.representation: 3+3 first passes the identity-local readiness seam, then one alias is removed without merging evidence buffers
arms.prediction: does not retroactively restore the missed evolution opportunity

exact_semantic_equivalence_contract: only Skill.name may differ in exact-split/placebo identities
same frozen semantic Experience hash across A-D and the pre-dedup portion of E
no full-credit broadcast or evidence duplication
primary_endpoints: PPO-Gate candidate J score and accept/reject decision
mechanism_endpoints: per-identity experience_buffer counts immediately before readiness
whether native maintenance/dedup occurs only after the missed readiness opportunity

p1_stochasticity_contract.author_sampling_policy: do not silently change Skill-Pro generation temperature/top-p merely to obtain deterministic or favorable outcomes
p1_stochasticity_contract.paired_seed_rule: canonical and quotient repetitions must share the same model/harness seed and evidence; split is expected to make zero post-readiness model calls

p1_decision_gate.pass_for_behavioral_replay: A and D both reach the model-dependent evolution path on the identical frozen evidence, C reaches neither candidate-generation nor PPO hooks, and at least one paired A/D run produces a valid frozen resulting pool suitable for replay.
p1_decision_gate.negative_or_inconclusive: If C unexpectedly reaches the path, evidence hashes differ, or A/D runtime validity cannot be established, stop P2 and diagnose rather than changing threshold, aliases, tasks, or focal skill.
p1_decision_gate.candidate_quality_not_required_for_mecha: P0/P1 can establish representation-dependent evolution opportunity even if generated candidates are rejected by PPO; however P2 requires a real resulting-pool difference and cannot be claimed from scheduler reachability alone.

p2_behavioral_replay.heldout_task_rule: freeze the next task/episode stream independently of P1 candidate quality and rewards before comparing resulting pools
p2_behavioral_replay.primary_behavioral_endpoint: episode return / task success as defined by the first-party environment
p2_behavioral_replay.required_interpretation: A behavioral difference must be mediated by the frozen P1 pool difference; aggregate task success alone cannot identify representation fragmentation.
p2_behavioral_replay.confirmatory_expansion_if_positive: pre-register a separate ALFWorld replication; do not substitute ALFWorld for a negative Mastermind result

cross_carrier_requirement.rule: choose the next carrier from source-level eligibility and operator fit, not from whether Skill-Pro produces a favorable P2 effect

next_authority_action: Run a separate runtime/model preflight and independent contract review. Only an explicit follow-on receipt may authorize P1 model calls; P2 remains conditional on the frozen P1 gate.
